final: SELECT g.player_id, g.bats, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM (SELECT a.player_id AS player_id, p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM all_star a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY a.player_id, p.bats) g CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(c.cnt) AS total FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM all_star a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY a.player_id, p.bats) c) t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
